items.title: Ship manual point-buy editing for the six ability scores
items.notes: Strength through Charisma with live point costs under 5e point-buy rules.

items.title: Fill the Player's Handbook standard array
items.notes: 15, 14, 13, 12, 10, 8 from Strength through Charisma.

items.title: Apply racial modifiers and variant bonuses from the documented race list
items.notes: Includes PHB races plus listed options from Volo's, Eberron, and Mordenkainen's as described in the README.

items.title: Support flexible ASI picks and race-granted choices
items.notes: Half-Elf, Variant Human, Changeling and similar flows for skills, languages, tools, cantrips, feats, and draconic ancestry.

items.title: Show live totals, remaining points, and ability modifiers
Ship a responsive Tailwind UI with a D&D-oriented palette
Manage calculator state with React Context
Ship English and Simplified Chinese UI locales
items.notes: Japanese, Macedonian, and Russian remain planned.

items.title: Add agent-ready docs, AGENTS.md, and name-roadmap files
items.notes: docs/, AGENTS.md, and roadmap/*.json derived from the README.

items.title: Complete the Simplified Chinese localization checklist
items.notes: Localize action feedback, validation, reset accessibility, footer text, feat names, and initial page metadata. Keep the locale in copied build links.

items.title: Add production SEO metadata, sitemap, robots, and JSON-LD
items.notes: Canonical URLs per locale, Open Graph/Twitter cards, WebApplication schema, crawlable about copy, and NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL.

items.title: Add score steppers and keep the budget visible on mobile
items.notes: Show the point cost of the next score increase and keep the budget summary visible while scrolling through ability scores on mobile.

items.title: Show missing character setup choices with links to their controls
items.notes: Update the checklist as applicable choices change and allow players to copy links to in-progress builds.

items.title: Add one-click Undo for Reset and Standard Array
items.notes: Restore the previous build while the result of the latest setup action is current.

items.title: Group ability bonus picks and name feat bonuses
items.notes: Show automatic bonuses, eligible abilities, and the selection limit in one picker. Include the feat name and +1 in the feat ability label.

items.title: Align Simplified Chinese race names and trait wording with official 5e usage
items.notes: Correct Aarakocra (阿拉寇拉), Firbolg, Shifter, and Tabaxi names; polish common language, fey ancestry, lucky, savage attacks, and pack tactics phrasing.

items.title: Polish Chinese tool group, feat, and breath labels
items.notes: Gaming sets to 游戏道具, Mage Slayer to 法师杀手, and remove number/character spaces in breath shape labels.

items.title: Align Chinese UI messages with official 5e phrasing
items.notes: Standard array, ASI, point budget, granted traits, automatic bonus, and score control aria spacing.

items.title: Locale-sort feats and group extra languages
items.notes: Sort feat options by localized label. Show Standard and Exotic language optgroups with locale-aware ordering inside each group.

items.title: Place Racial Traits between Ability scores and Build tools
items.notes: Keep traits beside the scores column so race details sit higher on the page than share/import actions.

items.title: Hide unready locales from the language selector
items.notes: Show only enabled locales in the dropdown; keep planned locales in PLANNED_LOCALES and the roadmap until they ship.

items.title: Update the calculator for D&D 5.5e (2024 Player's Handbook)
items.notes: Default to 2024 rules with ten species, sixteen backgrounds, and both background bonus distributions. Offer 2014 mode and preserve existing links and JSON builds.

items.title: Show feat effects and sources in setup, details, and print
items.notes: Add English and Simplified Chinese summaries for the 2014 Variant Human and 2024 Origin feats, with grant sources and any applicable ability increase.

items.title: Search and preview feats before selection
items.notes: Offer a localized feat picker for 2024 Humans and 2014 Variant Humans. Show prerequisites and preview 2014 ability increases before applying a choice.
